data.long_meaning: Reuelian is a Hebrew name meaning 'Friend of God'. It is derived from the Hebrew word 're' meaning 'friend' and 'el' meaning 'God'. In the Bible, there is a prophet named Reuel who gave Hagar the name Ishmael, meaning 'God hears'. This name signifies a strong connection with God and a faithful devotion to Him.

He was a descendant of the priestly line of Aaron and served as a spiritual leader and advisor to Hezekiah. Reuel's role was instrumental in the religious and political revival of Judah during this time, as he helped to lead the people back to the worship of Yahweh and to reject the idolatrous practices of other nations.
